models_evaluated: Cleveland Clinic locally derived VTE and bleeding risk prediction models

links.outcome: Total VTE and major bleeding events per 1000 patients, model-guided vs real-world clinician prophylaxis
links.effect: Model-based strategies produced 14.0-16.1 events per 1000 vs 14.3 for real-world practice; best model reduced prophylaxis by 55% and total events by 0.14%. Padua & IMPROVE caused the most total events.
links.quote: Overall, per 1000 patients, model-based strategies produced 14.0-16.1 events compared with 14.3 for real-world practice.

unlisted_practices: Model-guided pharmacologic VTE prophylaxis decision support to reduce overprophylaxis while balancing VTE and bleeding events

screen.reason: Retrospective simulation comparing real-world clinician judgment against hypothetical model-guided prophylaxis strategies/thresholds to evaluate clinical impact and efficiency.

primary.practice: risk threshold selection for prophylaxis clinical decision support
